topics.label: Lecture Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by connecting previous histopathology practicals to key concepts in cancer genetics and cellular transformation.

topics.label: Tumor Viruses, Proto-Oncogenes, and Transformation Assays
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics trace how the historical study of transforming viruses revealed cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays to measure cellular transformation.

topics.label: Mechanisms and Classification of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications of cancer-associated mutations and illustrate their mechanistic consequences on cell cycle regulation and protein activity.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Genetic Instability and Multi-Step Tumor Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore the molecular defects causing sequence and chromosomal instability and explain how they accelerate multi-step tumor progression.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition and Mutational Dynamics
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how inherited germline mutations accelerate cancer development and influence tumor biology and therapeutic response.
